show.name: Wan Jie Du Zun
show.summary: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

show.name: Spare Me, Great Lord!
show.summary: This is the story of an orphan, Lu Shu. He is not any regular orphan, but a metahuman experiencing the changes in himself, his country and the world during the dawn of the magical era. Watch as Lu Shu embarks on a journey to hone his peculiar abilities together with his sister, the adorable and charismatic Lu Xiaoyu. Along the way, they'll encounter supernatural events, obstacles and even the most powerful people in their country. How will Lu Shu make the best of his abilities and oust his never-ending list of rivals and opponents?

show.name: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
show.summary: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

show.name: Destined To Be Phoenix
show.summary: Yun Si impersonates her slain twin sister to exact revenge on Prince Huo Linye, pairing with Prince Huo Shenzhi.

show.name: Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
show.summary: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

show.name: Notes of DNA Appraiser
show.summary: Notes of DNA Appraiser tells the story of Xu Ziqi, a rookie DNA paternity tester. Under the guidance of Mo Li, director of the Xin Nuo Paternity Testing Center, she teams up with the passionate young man Zhu Xinchen. Together, they fearlessly confront a stream of appraisal cases and uncover all kinds of life truths.

show.name: Let's Go
show.summary: During the Republic of China era, Wang Laowu, a veterinarian by trade, accidentally becomes the county magistrate of Fuhu County. Once in office, he encounters endless troubles and fights his way through every obstacle in this absurd, comic tale. Centering on ordinary people, the drama reveals how small characters forge a grand era in Republican China.

show.name: The Palace Gambit
show.summary: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

show.name: Sunshine Through The Rain
show.summary: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.

show.name: Northern Storm
show.summary: In the late 1970s, Liu Haizhu, a young man from Songliao, intervenes to uphold justice and is swept into a jianghu conflict, where he forges a bond of life and death with Dong Batian. Through shifting times, he moves from an ordinary worker to a man entangled in the underworld, navigating brotherhood, tangled love and hate, and moral choices. He ultimately finds self-growth and redemption amid the ice and black soil.

show.name: Wherever Whoever Whatever
show.summary: Overworked, Bai Luoru flees to a village. With local support, she heals her past and mother's bond to live again.

show.name: Reborn in the Abyss
show.summary: A bizarre lightning strike causes the souls of Xiao Qingwan, the daughter of a noble family, and Li Mufan, the leader of Qingfeng Village, to be swapped. The two are forced to survive in each other's worlds, and they not only get involved in the grudges of the martial arts world, but also in the conflicts of the imperial court. They rediscover themselves in each other's identities and find their own path to change amidst the misalignment.

show.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
show.summary: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.
